text: some uncleanness: Heb. matter of nakedness | divorcement: Heb. cutting off
neither shall he be charged: Heb. not any thing shall pass upon him
lend thy brother any thing: Heb. lend the loan of any thing to, etc
setteth his heart upon it: Heb. lifteth his soul unto it
go over the boughes again: Heb. thou shalt not bough it after thee
